import gzip,hashlib,json,os,stat
from pathlib import Path
root=Path("/home/qian-qi/heptabao-ha-closure-20261103-r1/official271-snapshot-corruption-oracle-live-61ff-r1")
def identity(s):return(s.st_dev,s.st_ino,s.st_mode,s.st_uid,s.st_nlink,s.st_size,s.st_mtime_ns,s.st_ctime_ns)
def read(path):
 fd=os.open(path,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_NOFOLLOW)
 try:
  a=os.fstat(fd);assert stat.S_ISREG(a.st_mode) and a.st_uid==os.geteuid() and a.st_nlink==1 and a.st_size<=65536
  chunks=[]
  while True:
   part=os.read(fd,65536)
   if not part:break
   chunks.append(part)
  raw=b"".join(chunks);assert len(raw)==a.st_size and identity(a)==identity(os.fstat(fd))==identity(path.lstat())
  return raw
 finally:os.close(fd)
report_raw=read(root/"result.public.json")
assert hashlib.sha256(report_raw).hexdigest()=="c599c4a6679a76695e7df7ca6cc195ebb068e210493f8e63b32cb7690ff2edcc"
report=json.loads(report_raw)
assert report["http_intents"]==report["http_outcomes"]==89 and report["http_unknown"]==0 and report["all_owned_stopped"] is True
names=["result.public.json","prepared.public.json","roles_before.public.json"]+[f"operations/{i:04d}.{kind}.public.json" for i in range(1,90) for kind in ("intent","outcome")]
files={}
for name in names:
 raw=read(root/name);files[name]={"bytes":len(raw),"sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest(),"text":raw.decode()}
raw=(json.dumps({"schema":"heptabao.official271-corruption-original-public-journals.v1","files":files},sort_keys=True,separators=(",",":"))+"\n").encode()
packed=gzip.compress(raw,compresslevel=6,mtime=0)
path=root/"public-journals-r1.json.gz"
fd=os.open(path,os.O_WRONLY|os.O_CREAT|os.O_EXCL|os.O_NOFOLLOW,0o600)
with os.fdopen(fd,"wb")as f:f.write(packed);f.flush();os.fsync(f.fileno())
fd=os.open(root,os.O_RDONLY|os.O_DIRECTORY)
try:os.fsync(fd)
finally:os.close(fd)
assert path.read_bytes()==packed
print(json.dumps({"status":"public_journals_packed","files":len(files),"path":str(path),"gzip_bytes":len(packed),"gzip_sha256":hashlib.sha256(packed).hexdigest(),"raw_bytes":len(raw),"raw_sha256":hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()},sort_keys=True))
